provider_trade_holds:
CREATE INDEX idx_provider_trade_holds_profile
    ON provider_trade_holds(profile_id, state)

CREATE TABLE provider_trade_holds (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    profile_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    provider TEXT NOT NULL,
    trade_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    trade_status TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('held', 'cleared')),
    txids_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    cleared_reason TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (profile_id, provider, trade_id)
)
